findings.title: Missing WASM export breaks the whole wasm-inline entry, including existing encrypt/decrypt
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative: nothing shows that the pinned protect-ffi 0.29.0 lacks the WASM query exports, a CI e2e job exercises the import, and the finding admits it could not inspect the package.

findings.title: JSON containment/selector terms never row-matched in SQL; a wire mismatch would silently return no rows
findings.label: valid
findings.note: JSON containment and selector terms from the WASM path are never run against Postgres, so a wire mismatch would go undetected.

findings.title: Declared return type omits the bare-string selector result, so typed consumer code mis-handles it
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The declared return types have no string arm, yet selector queries return a bare string, so narrowing it with `in` would throw at runtime.

findings.title: Shipped guidance encourages laxer logging of deterministic query terms
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The shipped JSDoc encourages laxer logging of deterministic, plaintext-derived query terms, which can be linked to stored index terms.
